title: Beit Baitos
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Pesachim 57a, Abba Shaul ben Batnit said in the name of Abba Yosef ben Chanin: “Woe to me because of the house of Baitos; woe to me because of their clubs.” They were among the high priests of the Second Temple period.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Pesachim 57a has Abba Shaul ben Batnit citing Abba Yosef ben Chanin about the house of Baitos and its clubs, followed by the high-priestly families and their officials. This collective household notice does not identify it with a separately indexed individual Baitos.
